preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Number of vertices is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of edges is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s, t <= n and s != t
preconditions.description: Start and end vertices are within the range of vertices and are different.
Vertices connected by edges are within the range of vertices.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of paths from s to t whose length differs from the shortest path by no more than 1, modulo 10^9 + 7.
